allOf.description: CloudEvents 1.0 context attributes; every attribute is required in this fleet.

id.description: UUID v4, minted once per occurrence and stable across outbox redelivery.

subject.description: Aggregate instance id; equal to the Kafka message key.

work_unit_id.description: The completed task's order reference (empty only when the task can no longer be found at publish time).

associate_id.description: Occupant checked into the completing station at publish time; omitted when none (e.g. a robot station).

duration_seconds.description: Seconds between claim and completion; omitted when the claim time is unknown.

task_type.description: The completed task's own type; omitted only when the task can no longer be found.

order_ref.description: The order the completed task belongs to; the key inventory-storage uses to confirm picks. Optional and additive (the event stays v1) and omitted when the task has no order reference. Distinct from work_unit_id, which for order work is the per-line work unit id.

line_no.description: The 1-based order line the completed task's work was released for (copied from WorkReleased.line_no, ADR-0041); with order_ref it lets inventory-storage confirm the pick of exactly that line's reservation. Optional and additive (the event stays v1) and omitted when unknown (transfer work, a release without line_no, or an older task). Never derived from the work_unit_id.

sku.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only (ADR-0047, ADR-0050; additive, the event stays v1). The SKU the executed move relocated, from WorkReleased.data.relocation.sku / WorkReleased.data.replenishment.sku. Omitted on every other task type.

from_bin.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only. The bin the stock left - the planned from_bin, or for a RELOCATE Assign move the bin the operator scanned at completion.

to_bin.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only. The bin the stock went to - the planned to_bin, or for a RELOCATE Vacate move the reserve bin the operator scanned at completion. Always different from from_bin.

quantity.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only. The units the operator counted and confirmed at completion (RELOCATE v1 moves the whole on-hand quantity of the SKU at from_bin; for REPLENISH it is the confirmed count, which may differ from the planned quantity).

relocation_ref.description: RELOCATE only. The move reference `<plan_id>:<move_seq>` copied from WorkReleased.data.relocation; inventory-storage records it as the StockRelocated source_ref, and slotting-optimization matches it back to the plan's move.

request_ref.description: REPLENISH only (ADR-0050; additive, the event stays v1; mirrors relocation_ref). The replenishment request id copied from WorkReleased.data.replenishment.request_id; inventory-storage records it as the StockRelocated source_ref (reason REPLENISHMENT) and pick-face-replenishment closes the request by it. Omitted on every other task type.
